subject: GreenCircuit: consolidating Whistic & Vendr profiles + CAIQ gap list
messages:
From: Laura Chen <security@greencircuit.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor portals: Whistic + Vendr profiles; CAIQ targets

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this — GreenCircuit is consolidating security intake across two portals (Whistic + Vendr) and we want to make sure Redwood's profiles and attachments line up with our procurement timeline. Attached is our SIG/CAIQ questionnaire set and an initial list of required evidence.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide a canonical export (Whistic & Vendr) and a CAIQ-to-profile mapping we can ingest? Specific asks: 
- Confirm who at Redwood owns the Whistic profile and the Vendr account.
- Provide a snapshot export (CSV/JSON) of current answers plus links to uploaded artifacts.
- Identify any SIG/CAIQ gaps you anticipate from a quick pass.

Timing: procurement needs a clean handoff by 2026-07-15. If we can sync for 30 minutes early next week, that would be ideal.

Attachments: Greencircuit_SIG_questions.pdf (SIG + CAIQ extract)

Thanks — Laura
Laura Chen
Head of Vendor Security
GreenCircuit

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <security@greencircuit.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-26T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portals: Whistic + Vendr profiles; CAIQ targets

Hi Laura — thanks for the packet and the clear timeline. We're happy to support and can deliver the exports and a draft mapping. Quick internal plan (to keep you in the loop):

1) Inventory export (Whistic + Vendr) — Kimberly will pull the current profile exports and a manifest of uploaded artifacts.
2) CAIQ mapping (internal draft) — Jasmine will do a field-by-field mapping from your CAIQ extract to our profile fields and flag missing evidence.
3) Evidence handoff — we'll confirm whether to upload artifacts to Vendr, share direct links, or presign an S3 bundle for your ingestion.
4) Sync & signoff — propose a 30-min call to review the draft mapping and a prioritized gap list.

Action items: 
- Kimberly: please export Whistic CSV & Vendr manifest and attach to the thread by EOD 6/27.
- Jasmine: start mapping CAIQ columns; target a draft by 6/28.
- Laura: please confirm if we should upload artifacts into your Vendr org or if you prefer a presigned S3 bundle.

I'll schedule a tentative 30-min slot for 2026-07-01 10:00 AM PT; please let me know if that doesn't work.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-27T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portals: Whistic + Vendr profiles; CAIQ targets

Markus / Kimberly — quick technical note from my mapping pass. I'm attaching an internal draft workbook (GC_SIG_CAIQ_mapping_v1.xlsx) that shows: 

- Whistic column -> CAIQ control ID mapping (sheet: whistic_map)
- Vendr manifest fields and attachment pointers (sheet: vendr_manifest)
- Flags for controls that require a PDF/diagram (sheet: evidence_flags)

A few gotchas to call out: 
- Vendr API rate limits are 120 requests/min for manifest pulls; bulk exports are available but require admin API tokens. Kimberly, if you can pull a manifest export (JSON) I'll convert to the mapping format.
- For prefix-anchored evidence (diagram/png) we should use a temporary S3 staging bucket with presigned URLs and a short TTL (48h). That avoids sharing full admin credentials.
- Several CAIQ items map to internal-runbooks that aren't yet public (incident runbook, infra recovery checklist). For the security review we'll include redacted samples and offer to host an evidence walkthrough if GreenCircuit wants deeper artifacts.

I'll push the draft workbook to this thread. If Laura confirms Vendr upload permission, I can also push a CSV formatted per their ingestion spec.

-Jasmine
Applied ML / Platform Security
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Laura — following up with a consolidated plan and the two attachments (draft mapping + your SIG extract). Summary / asks: 

Plan & deliverables
- By EOD 2026-06-27: Whistic CSV export + Vendr manifest (Kimberly posted the manifest to our internal bucket).
- By EOD 2026-06-28: internal draft CAIQ->profile mapping (attached: GC_SIG_CAIQ_mapping_v1.xlsx).
- By 2026-07-02: we will either (a) push CSV + attachments into your Vendr org if you confirm org write access, or (b) provide a presigned S3 bundle (48h TTL) with all artifacts for you to ingest.

Immediate asks for GreenCircuit:
- Please confirm preferred ingestion method (Vendr upload vs presigned S3).
- If Vendr upload, provide the admin account/email to grant uploader permissions (we will request a short-lived API token).
- If presigned S3, confirm an S3 bucket prefix or provide us an upload target.

Call: I scheduled a tentative 30-min sync for 2026-07-01 10:00 AM PT. If that works, Kimberly and Jasmine will walk through the mapping and we can align on the gap list for procurement.

Attachments included: GC_SIG_CAIQ_mapping_v1.xlsx, Greencircuit_SIG_questions.pdf

Thanks — we'll keep this thread updated as artifacts move.

-Markus
